description: Read one person's record in the Bibliothèque nationale de France authority file, by the identifier search_authors returns. It carries the dates and places of birth and death, the occupation the record names, the language and country it associates with the person, the field of activity with its Dewey class, and the addresses for the same person in VIAF, IdRef, DBpedia, Wikidata and ISNI. It carries no biography. The field the BnF calls biographical information is a job title on most records and a single word on many, so quote it as what the catalogue states and do not build a life story out of it. It lists no work. list_works walks from this record to the works the catalogue names the person the creator of, and states what that link does and does not reach. 'depictions' are images data.bnf.fr attaches to the person. They are links for a person to open; this server does not read them, and an image can be a page that mentions the person rather than a portrait of them.

author_id.description: The identifier from search_authors, such as 'cb119219976'. A full data.bnf.fr address is accepted too.

include_depictions.description: Include the images data.bnf.fr attaches to the person. A well-known person can carry dozens, so they are left out by default. find_digitised gathers them with everything else.

name: get_author

biographical_information.description: What the record states about the person. This is a job title on most records and a single word on many; it is not a biography.

catalogue_url.description: The address of this record in the BnF general catalogue, as the record itself points at it. Null when the record states none, which is a silence in the record rather than a record the general catalogue lacks: no address is built in its place.

dewey_classes.description: Dewey classes the fields point at, such as '800' for literature.

fields.description: Fields of activity in the words of the record.

label.description: The authority heading, usually with the dates.

other_names.description: Other headings the record carries, including transliterations and pen names.

record_created.description: When the authority record was created.

same_as.description: Addresses for the same person in other files, grouped by file.

depiction_count.description: Images on Gallica that the record points at, counted whether or not they were returned. An illustration the record holds elsewhere is not counted, because this server describes Gallica documents and knows nothing about the others.

ark.description: The Gallica ARK identifying the document.

from_id.description: The record this link hangs off.

rendering.description: The view the address asks Gallica for, read off what follows the ARK name in it, such as 'thumbnail' for a small image or 'item' for one leaf. Null when the address names the document itself. This says what was asked for, not what comes back.

role.description: 'reproduction' is the edition itself digitised. 'ocr' is the text a machine read off it. 'depiction' is an image illustrating the record, which can be a portrait or a page mentioning the subject rather than the work.

url.description: The address the catalogue publishes, for a person to open. Read it beside 'rendering': an address asking for a rendering opens that view of the document rather than the document. This server does not read either.

retrieved_at.description: When these metadata were read from data.bnf.fr, as an ISO 8601 instant. The BnF licence asks for this date to be stated wherever the metadata are shown, so repeat it alongside the source.

title: Read a person's record
